title: Things changed while Asha was deciding
story: A request steps up. Before Asha opens the link, she cancels ShopBot's permission from another device, forgets, then opens the link and taps Approve. On approval the Guard re-checks everything, so the result is blocked, not approved.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Order the party food from FreshMart for Saturday.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The party order at FreshMart comes to INR 6,000. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Actually, cancel ShopBot's permission to pay for me.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The INR 6,000 order is still waiting for your approval on your phone.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The approval was blocked: my permission was withdrawn, so I won't pay.

what_to_notice: The approval is checked again against the Mandate as it is now. It was revoked, so the approval is blocked with MANDATE_REVOKED: an approval can never bring back a permission that was withdrawn.
